title: New on the Shelf: 5 Non-Alcoholic Beers Just In at NA Beer Market
excerpt: An olive oil pilsner, a pecan pie fall brew and three more new NA beers just landed. Grab single cans and build your own 12-pack.
intro:
Fresh cans just hit the shelf, and this batch has range. There's a pilsner brewed with olive oil, a fall brew that tastes like pecan pie, and a couple of easy drinkers for whatever this week throws at you.

Whatever your reason for reaching for an NA beer, here are five new ones worth a spot in your fridge. Every one is a single can, so you can try them all without committing to a case.

blurbs.41163: Athletic teamed up with Graza on this one, and yes, it's brewed with extra virgin olive oil. It still drinks like a classic pils, smooth and crisp, with an herbal edge that makes it a great match for anything salty off the grill or the cutting board.
blurbs.41160: Toasted pecans and dark brown sugar over a deep ruby malt base. This limited fall release is the closest thing to dessert in a can, and it's built for sweater weather and the Thanksgiving table.
blurbs.41083: Golden, floral and lightly honeyed, this is the classic American beer you grew up seeing at every cookout, without the alcohol. Keep a few cold for game day.
blurbs.41063: Inspired by Sawtooth Brewery's False Summit Amber, Prospect is all toasty caramel malt from Idaho 2-row barley. A great pick if you like a beer with a little more body.
blurbs.41020: Rakau, El Dorado and Idaho 7 hops bring big tropical and citrus aroma, with no fruit in the kettle. Juicy, medium-bodied and barely bitter. Only a few cans left, so don't wait on this one.

outro: Can't pick just one? Mix any of these into a Build Your Own 12-Pack and discover your new favorite NA beer. Free shipping on every order to all 50 states.
